in_marathi.name: Megha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Megha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Megha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Megha' which means 'cloud'. It is a popular name in Hindu culture and is often given to girls born during the monsoon season when the sky is filled with clouds.
